description: The two lines that read the current provider config and AI flag from refs at call time, avoiding stale settings.

steps.description: Read `providerConfigRef.current` and `aiEnabledRef.current` at call time. The comment says this is always the latest value, even mid-await, so a slow API call cannot use stale settings.
The comment explains a `useEffect` keeps `providerConfigRef.current` in sync whenever the settings change, which is why the ref holds the current config.

title: Reading Config from a Ref
